scope: four decodable reference codes for categorical snapshots with explicit bit accounting

checks.round_trip: raw, uniform-alphabet, run-length and finite-period codes round-trip empty, singleton, short randomized and structured u32 sequences
checks.accounting: check independent bitstreams for a fixed short sequence, including family and length, model and data bits
checks.relabeling: an injective u32 relabeling preserves every code length while decoding the new labels exactly
checks.rejection: truncation, nonzero final padding, impossible categorical indices, adjacent duplicate runs, impossible periods and resource caps fail explicitly
checks.offline: report exact lengths from independently authored traces without a substrate; preserve existing tier-0 output and run the cross-platform matrix

limits: deterministic engineering baselines for categorical data only. Nonuniform IID, fitting and scientific interpretation are separate work.
